lines.text: In this world, everyone has a number above their head.
The higher your number, the stronger you are.
A baker? 12.
A cop? 140.
The champion? 9,999.
Your number decides everything.
Where you live. Who steps aside on the street.
Mine has been 1. My whole life.
Today is the Rising, the one day a year numbers can change.
The whole city fills the arena.
On stage, Champion Vex. 9,999.
Nobody has ever beaten him.
Then the screen calls a name. Mine.
Everyone laughs.
Vex doesn't even look at me. He just pushes.
I fly across the stage.
I should stay down. Every 1 stays down.
But I get up. And my number changes.
He hits me again. I get up. 10.
Again. 100.
The arena goes silent.
Because nobody ever told us what the number really counts.
It's not strength.
It's how many times you got back up.
The screen flashes. Two choices.
Hit back. Or walk away.
You decide. Comment hit, or walk.
Most votes is part 2.
